description: Überschwemmungsgebiet (ÜSG) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by rips-datenlink.lubw.de. Floodplains are areas that are flooded in the event of flooding of an above-ground body of water. The determination of the ÜSG is based on different criteria (Water Act § 65). Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Flooding area (ÜSG)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Hochwasserschutz, oac: 39. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2023-12-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
